entities.name: Momolu Duwalu Bukele
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Momolu Duwalu Bukele, living in the 19th century, was the proliferator of the Vai syllabary derived from the Poro Society, used for writing the Vai language of Liberia—one of several African languages to develop its own writing system.
